label: DELVE/DELVE DR3 Gold (US-East, S3)
name: DELVE DR3 Gold
description: The DELVE DR3 catalog contains data from the DECam All Data Everywhere (DECADE) and DES DR2 processing at NCSA using the DES Data Management (DESDM) pipeline. It contains ~2.6 billion unique objects and covers ~20,000 deg² in all four bands (g, r, i, z) simultaneously.
